source_revision: not-reviewed: provider terms not read; automation surface per Google's Antigravity CLI documentation (antigravity.google/docs/cli/headless, /docs/permissions, /docs/sandbox, retrieved 2026-10-13) as recorded in TDD 4.4, and the 2026-10-14 live checks (docs/research/live-checks-2026-10-14-antigravity.md, agy 1.3.4)
notes: Added by T4.32 (2026-10-14, Delegated agent work, not owner-approved). The range admits no version (ADR-0009, ROADMAP 6.8 conventions): the adapter fails the version gate with ADAPTER_VERSION_UNVERIFIED until `switchboard adapters validate antigravity` passes a version, so nothing here is a claim that any agy version is validated. Automation surface: `agy --prompt=<prompt> --output-format stream-json`, one process per run, not ACP (TDD 4.4 transport decision; the separate ACP server does not reuse agy's login); `agy --version` for the version. Flags cited by TDD 4.4 source [H] and observed in `agy --help` in the 2026-10-14 live check: -p/--print/--prompt (the `--prompt=` form is an Assumption), --output-format (text, json, stream-json), --dangerously-skip-permissions (bypass-class, only for an approved privileged scope that sets bypass), --conversation. Never emitted: --sandbox, --mode, --model, --effort, --agent, -c/--continue, --print-timeout, --remote-control, --gemini_dir, --add-dir, --project, --new-project, --input-format; GEMINI_API_KEY, GOOGLE_API_KEY and GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL stay out of the environment and API-key mode stays disabled (ADR-0003); AGY_CLI_DISABLE_AUTO_UPDATE=true is set. The argv audit refuses --dangerously-skip-permissions, its one-dash spelling, --remote-control, --gemini_dir and --add-dir (both spellings) outside an approved privileged bypass run (registry entry; ADR-0035, ADR-0045). Compile matrix (Delegated, fail closed, TDD 4.4.2, Q-63 and Q-84): inspect-untrusted, edit-untrusted, test-sandboxed and trusted-development are Ineligible (PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED): toolPermission is a settings value with no per-run flag, init.permission_mode was request-review in every live run including --sandbox and --mode=plan, and a repository's .agents MCP server and hook ran with no approval. privileged compiles only for an approved scope with bypass true, worktree files, shell broad, network on, repository_config enabled and no requested model, as --dangerously-skip-permissions without --sandbox: Antigravity confines nothing in that run; the controller's worktree, the tool-call guard (ADR-0039), FR-GIT-03 and FR-GIT-06 remain. Auth (T4.34): UNKNOWN until implemented; the live check found `agy models` exits 1 quickly when logged out. Parser (T4.33): reads only the stream-json fields the live check recorded (init conversation_id and model; tool step_update lines; result status, response, usage, error and denied_actions); success needs status SUCCESS, reported tokens and no denied_actions (Q-86); resume is not compiled, because an unknown --conversation id silently starts a new conversation (Q-86). Soft denials, --print-timeout expiry and an unknown --conversation id all exit 0 with status SUCCESS, so the parser must read denied_actions and never trust exit 0 alone. Git writes (FR-GIT-01): no declared control (ADR-0039); commitChannel finalize-only (no per-run MCP definition). Credentials: Switchboard never reads, copies, logs or exports Antigravity credentials or settings (including the token file in the CLI state directory), never starts the sign-in and never scrapes dashboards (ADR-0003, FR-AUTH-02). Terms: this manifest records that the CLI documents headless use (technical evidence only); it makes no claim that any use complies with Google's terms (NFR-COMP-01). Review date: 2026-10-14 (Delegated agent review, not owner-approved). Linux only; macOS (NFR-PORT-02) and Windows (NFR-PORT-03) are not supported.
